summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Hands-on experience training and evaluating segmentation, classification, and detection models, from fine-tuning VLMs like DONUT to building CUDA-optimized edge inference pipelines. Built automated ground-truth data generation pipelines and rigorous eval harnesses (Dice, IoU, mAP) to close accuracy gaps under real deployment constraints, moving fluidly between PyTorch model development, OpenCV-based perception, and production edge deployment on Jetson hardware.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a custom data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset with medical imaging augmentation and batch-loading memory management for 3D volumetric inputs.
Trained U-Net segmentation models with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated using Dice Score and IoU, and reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT, an OCR-free visual document understanding transformer, on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API, improving validation accuracy from 55% to 93% through preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom toothbrush detection dataset for health-level classification using YOLOv8.
Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for edge deployment.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system integrating a Flask-SocketIO edge server with a Jetson and Arduino controller over a unified WebSocket fabric.
Integrated faster-whisper STT, Gemini intent classification, and TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms) for visual servoing with dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping.
Resolved 11 integration failures through systematic root-cause analysis; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated data generation pipelines using CARLA's semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18) with SoftmaxFocalLoss + ParsingRelationLoss; validated in a closed-loop control stack with zero collisions across multiple laps.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B, profiling peak VRAM and inference latency with pynvml.
Built an evaluation harness across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC benchmarks; measured <1% accuracy degradation for near-lossless edge deployment.
